# papertrade-terminal

> Unofficial, non-custodial trading terminal for Papertrade (1000x synthetic perps on Hyperliquid HyperEVM, chain 999). Not affiliated with Papertrade. High leverage can lose your whole margin.

Connect an injected wallet, sign one RegisterSessionKey message, then trade with a browser session key (can trade, cannot withdraw). Charts, positions, deposit/withdraw and a KyberSwap swap included.

## Links

- [Terminal](https://papertrade-terminal.pages.dev/): the app. Use ?watch=0x... for a read-only account view.
- [Source](https://github.com/nirholas/papertrade-terminal): Apache-2.0 licensed.
- [papertrade-sdk](https://github.com/nirholas/papertrade-sdk): the protocol SDK this app is built on.
- [papertrade-ai](https://github.com/nirholas/papertrade-ai): MCP server and CLI for agents.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/papertrade-terminal/blob/main/AGENTS.md): rules for agents.

## Notes for agents

- The app is a UI; it exposes no HTTP API of its own beyond a same-origin proxy at /api/papertrade/* for the public Papertrade API.
- Never sign or send transactions on a user's behalf. All signing happens in the user's wallet or their browser session key.
